projects.name: | Societe Generale Global Solution Center Pvt Ltd Jan 2022 – Jun 2024
details: Key Deliverables

Driving a cross-functional team for KYC, review management, reopen of clients’ transformation ∙ Collaborating with project management on transformation initiatives aiming at automation and efficiency gains

Driving a cross-functional team for finance, p2p, accounting and reporting, regulatory reporting, - working on mode frameworks on transformational initiatives aiming at automations, efficiency gains and risk management
Analyzing production trends, bottlenecks, process step issues, and suggestions for changes/enhancements to the E2E (end-to-end) processes
Managed end-to-end program governance including risk management, issue tracking, milestone reporting and stakeholder communications across KYC and onboarding transformation programs.
Supported regulatory change initiatives and Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) programs focused on onboarding optimization, process standardization and operational efficiency.
Facilitated steering committee discussions and prepared executive presentations supporting transformation investment decisions.
Collaborated with business partners on organizational change and the impact assessment of such change on risk control frameworks, people, technology and processes.
Supported in mobilizing best practices and transformations initiatives utilizing the operating model design framework
Contributed to mutualization of projects including assessment or current state process, documentation of key pain points, and development of recommendations in the global operating models.
Co-ordinated with Process Owners to plan process continuous improvement efforts and identify best practices
